title: Negative control: identical evidence presented in both positions
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC FICTIONAL EVIDENCE prepared for a pre-registered prompt experiment. Not a factual claim about any real country, territory or person. No real dossier data is used.
design: REVISED per independent review. Both copies are byte-identical evidence; there is no per-copy position field - presentation position is created only by the renderer's order, so no retained string can conflict after a swap. The renderer must not announce that the copies match. Divergence is a diagnostic consistency failure, not proof of a systematic position effect; a tie is not evidence of general calibration.
expected_reasoning: The presented dossiers carry the same evidence, so each variant must give the same assessment to both; a difference is a diagnostic consistency failure.
A tie is an expected and permitted outcome here; forcing a difference would violate the output instructions.
No fact may be invented to justify separating the dossiers, and neither may receive concealment credit.

copy_left.label: SYNTHETIC-P4
copy_left.summary: Fictional jurisdiction with a small documented evidence base and no trans-specific criminal offence.
documented_evidence: No criminal offence targeting trans visitors is documented.
Documented social curiosity without hostility; no threats or violence in the record.
One documented incident in 2018: a visitor was verbally insulted in a market; no injury, no complaint filed, no state involvement, no repeat.
No facility, custody or document rule is documented; border processing is described as ordinary.
uncertainties: No counts exist for how often visitors are identified as trans by any route.
No complaint remedy specific to trans visitors is documented.
